Package it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.controller

Class RecipeController

java.lang.Object
it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.controller.RecipeController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/recipes") public class RecipeController extends Object
REST Controller for viewing and searching recipes with public access.

      @GetMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<ShowRecipeDTO> getRecipe(@PathVariable String id)
      Retrieves the detailed information of a specified recipe.

    • getRecipeByTitle

      @GetMapping("/search/{title}/{pageNumber}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<SliceRecipeDTO<UserPreviewRecipeDTO>> getRecipeByTitle(@PathVariable String title, @PathVariable int pageNumber)
      Searches for recipes by title (using substring matching) to display on the home page. Returns a paginated list with five recipes per page.
      Parameters:
      title - the substring to search for within recipe titles
      pageNumber - the requested page number for pagination
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity containing a list of UserPreviewRecipeDTO with the paginated search results
      See Also:
      • RecipeService.getRecipeByTitle(String, int)
